d:
Deepak Sahni Founder built a ₹3,000 crore diagnostics empire, then his own reports hid his liver disease for a decade.
He explains:
• Why his liver was ageing ten years faster than his body while every standard test came back completely normal
• How he cut his own medication by 75 percent in just four months after finding what routine diagnostics had missed
• How to start a healthcare startup and how much money you actually need before your first investor
• What happened when he built one of India's largest diagnostics businesses from zero to ₹3,000 crore
